{{Quote
| In recognition of your noble efforts, and as one small step to solving the problem, I have decreed a grand gift should be given! A bellhome of your very own!
A place to reflect. A bed to lay in. It's hanging up there at the top, beside our good pinmaster.

| Hr = SS

The <b>Bellhome Key</b> is an [[Items (Silksong)#Keys|item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Used to open the bell located above [[Bellhart]], allowing access to the [[bellhome]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bellhome.png!Bellhome location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Bellhome 01.png!Bellhome in Bellhart
}}

== How to Acquire ==
[[Pavo]] gives the Bellhome Key to Hornet after completing <i>[[Bellhart's Glory]]</i><ref group = Source>FSM <code>Belltown Greeter NPC - Dialogue</code> in <code>belltown.bundle</code> checking <code>PlayerData.BelltownHouseState</code>.</ref> and 2 of the following Wishes:<ref group = Source><code>Belltown House Key</code> in <code>dataassets/questsystem/completetotalgroups.bundle</code>.</ref>
* <i>[[Silver Bells]]</i>
* <i>[[My Missing Courier]]</i>
* <i>[[My Missing Brother]]</i>
* <i>[[Savage Beastfly (Wish)|Savage Beastfly]]</i>
